description: Approved on the fz-sc8.66 page. When main returns while a child still waits on a timer, Elixir ends the program, and run and interp agree. The native build keeps running the child and prints its output. Done when: the native build ends when main returns, and an oracle fixture with a child still waiting agrees on interp, run and build.
title: [BUG] The program ends when the main process returns, on the native build too
